correctness.rationale: Independently decoded all fifteen 36-bit upper-triangle regular nine-vertex tournament strings, constructed the 9 four-element out-neighborhood facets and all 1278 nonempty faces, checked complete partition of every face across 616 stored matched pairs and 46 critical faces, and topologically sorted every directed Hasse graph with no cycles. Critical counts are one 0-cell and the claimed 1- and 2-cells per each of 15 representatives, giving eight homotopy types. For the unique mixed case (index 9) independent rational boundary elimination gives ranks rank(d2)=25, rank(d3)=9 on 35 triangles, hence beta2=1, so its sole 2-cell has attaching degree zero to the 1-cell. The complete set of 15 order-nine regular isomorphism classes depends on McKay catalogue, not solely on checking these 15 examples for regularity and pairwise nonisomorphism.
